hero.label: COLOMBIA'S AIRLINE
hero.subtitle: We are Colombia's aerial bridge. Since 1962 we connect hearts, develop regions and bring tourism to over 45 destinations. Discover what we are.
quienes.descripcion: We are much more than an airline; we are the arm that connects the heart of Colombia. Founded on April 12, 1962 by decree of President Alberto Lleras Camargo, our purpose has always been the same: to bring development and connectivity to the most remote corners of our country.
quienes.mision: To fly, serve, integrate and promote the development of the regions, through a safe and quality flight experience.
quienes.vision: To be the airline that connects the heart of Colombians, being innovative, technological and sustainable.

globe.bridge_desc: Every line traced is a real route. Every bright point, a destination waiting for you.
